summary: Strong set anchored by the OpenAI/Astra 'critical' cybersecurity classification and the autonomous Hugging Face exploit story, both carried by primary or first-hand sources with distinct angles. Two paired items (OpenAI+sama on Astra; deedydas+mattturck on the HF exploit) are same-event/distinct-angle and are kept. sama is overrepresented across selected items (Astra release policy + Oklo criticality). The Karpathy microGPT item is sourced only through a third-party hype account (0xMortyx) with no primary tweet located, a source-traceability weakness; it is kept but flagged, with a primary-source search suggested. Remainder are concrete, well-sourced releases and research results.
